note: Both sets capture the same five core facts (40W incandescent, 9W CFL, 7W LED, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor dimming bypass), and all quotes and bindings are supported by the page. Set A is more redundant, repeating every fact twice (10 claims for 5 facts), while Set B repeats only three facts (8 claims for 5 facts), so B adds less trivial clutter. Neither set captures the Title 24 requirement that high-efficacy luminaires be on their own switch in kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms, so both are equally incomplete there. Set B's abbreviated vacancy-sensor value ('bypass dimming function to completely disconnect electricity') is still faithful to the source.
